desc: Read and parse N, Q, A, and queries; coordinate-compress A values for Fenwick indices.

Implement one-pass offline sweep by R: dp[i] = 1 + Fenwick max over values strictly < A_i; update Fenwick at rank(A_i) with dp[i]; after processing i, answer queries with R_i==i via Fenwick max over values ≤ X_i.
Handle X mapping to largest compressed A value ≤ X (using bisect_right), and output answers in original query order with fast I/O; verified samples 1 and 2.
Sanity-check strictness: dp uses strict `<` (prefix rank(A_i)-1), query uses non-strict `≤` (bisect_right count).
